notes.title: Gangsters 1902 got major update!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update for “Gangsters 1920” on PC and SCILL-support
notes.notes:
[b]Today the retro-style adventure game “Gangsters 1920” gets an update for PC on Steam. In addition the game gets SCILL-Support.[/b]

About SCILL
SCILL™ Play, 4Players' latest innovation project, adds a new layer of engagement to existing and future games.
The second-screen app, developed for iOS and Android smartphones and tablets, integrates seamlessly into supported games and allows players to challenge their own performance in real time. Successful challenges are rewarded with achievements, leaderboard entries and exclusive rewards.
SCILL™ Play opens up new possibilities for players and publishers alike and deepens their gaming experience even further.

Explore the gloomy roads of the surreal 1920s underworld and find the relevant hints. Together with detective Lake, you will be able to hunt down the gangsters responsible for the national bank robbery. Better be safe than sorry – find out who your friends are before encountering your foes. The right people will do you a favor and give you the two clues, the wrong people will kill you.


Thanks to the great and positive Feedback to all players...
Changes:
- View-problems with surreal dog fixed
- Music at the end added
- Player, change direction optimized
- Glow effect is now only on item, not in front of the player
- Problems with the bullet of Gangsters fixed
- Performance optimizing’s
- Small bugfixes

notes.title: Update for “Gangsters 1920”
notes.notes:
Today the retro-style adventure game “Gangsters 1920” gets an update for PC on Steam.

The update fixes small bugs and brings performance-optimizations.
